purpose: Isolate read-error effects from small-plasmid recovery. This is a design record, not a runnable benchmark configuration.
reference_scope: Derived subsets of the deposited assemblies; all other plasmids, including small native plasmids, excluded. Do not call these complete native complements.
matched_design: For each selected subset, compare error-free and noisy conditions from the same frozen source fragments and geometry. Keep coverage and read-length settings fixed across conditions.
error_profiles: Retain the previous declared matched-exact, generic-stress and historical ONT-shaped comparisons; do not describe them as calibrated current Nanopore chemistry.
assessment_requirements: Keep exact reference equality separate from tolerant/continuous recovery.
The current small-plasmid-tolerant-v1 evaluator is not validated for these larger plasmids; do not extend its supported accessions or size limit without validation.
Record per-molecule coverage, identity, continuity and output length with provenance; define and validate the larger-plasmid endpoint before execution.
Compare each noisy outcome with its own clean control; a clean-control failure cannot be attributed to read errors.
admission_gates: Every selected input has exactly one chromosome and one plasmid >=20,000 bp, and no other plasmids.
Larger-plasmid assessment and truth controls validated before this becomes a runnable configuration.
execution_status: Not submitted; no new simulations, alignments or assembly jobs are implied.
